0x0025F0.en: 「One of the Four Spirits... the Ouryu Chokijin.」

0x00262A.en: 「Let me show you the OhRyuKoh's power.」

0x00265E.en: 「Super Robots of the Four Spirits... behold.」

0x002695.en: 「If everyone just became an immortal,/　we'd all live happy as can be.」

0x002719.en: 「Don't you all want to live it up/　in paradise, having fun?」

0x00276C.en: 「The god of Baral is the one true guardian of Earth.」

0x0027AC.en: 「Rest easy./　After you die, we'll guard the Earth.」

0x002836.en: 「Heh heh... I wonder how long/　that finite life of yours can last?」

0x002886.en: 「Let me show you the Ouryu's power.」

0x0028B7.en: 「The last scene of your life.../ Let me direct it for you.」

0x00293B.en: 「If you're begging for life, keep it brief.」

0x00296F.en: 「Heh... looking at you,/ you remind me of someone I fought long ago.」

0x0029F3.en: 「Let me teach you that/ willpower alone gets you nowhere.」

0x002A8F.en: 「If you're that man's kin, no mercy.」

0x002AFA.en: 「Heh.../ Seems you share the same power I do.」

0x002B75.en: 「Your psychic power and mine are worlds apart.」

0x002BB5.en: 「You've got quite the psychic power./ But still...」

0x002BFF.en: 「Do you know the roots of your power?」

0x002C36.en: 「Once shikai'd,/ you'd make fine assets for us.」

0x002C86.en: 「Chosen of the Chokijin.../ Offer that power to the god Baral.」

0x002CE5.en: 「If you shikai'd, you could live a long life.」

0x002D19.en: 「Brooklyn... let's keep it nice and cool.」

0x002E2C.en: 「Kusuha... if you won't come to me,/ I'll have to hurt you.」

0x002EC5.en: 「A hollow soul with strong psychic power... unbalanced.」

0x002F02.en: 「Seems there's something/ dangerous mixed in you.」

0x002F4C.en: 「Your souls are hollow./ No, souls were never...」

0x002FD9.en: 「Too bad, you can't become an immortal.」

0x003010.en: 「That machine of yours/ carries a curious device.」

0x003094.en: 「Even a V.B. descendant gets no mercy.」

0x0030CB.en: 「Chokijin of the Four Gods.../ You block me once more?」

0x003112.en: 「Let me teach you the gap in rank between Chokijin.」

0x00314F.en: 「You think a mere Seiryu/ can beat the Ouryu?」

0x00319F.en: 「Four Spirits and Four Gods... the gap is clear.」

0x003207.en: 「If you'll tuck tail and run,/ now's the time.」

0x00327F.en: 「Can a steel dragon beat the Ouryu?」

0x0032AD.en: 「Sink that ship and/ it's game over... maybe?」

0x0032F7.en: 「Those who defy god/ must be devils, no?」

0x003372.en: 「My, my, what a fine show you gave.」

0x003429.en: 「Hehe... let's keep it nice and fair.」

0x003463.en: 「Sorry, but bear with me a bit longer.」

0x0034A0.en: 「This is it. That was a real thrill!」

0x0035A1.en: 「I'd rather not dirty/ my favorite suit.」

0x0037CA.en: 「You hurl your psychic power straight at me.」

0x003807.en: 「You're drawing in a nasty thing./ Well, I'll just break it.」

0x00386F.en: 「That machine invites disaster. Now, and later too.」

0x0038CB.en: 「No way you got that power/ by mere chance...」

0x00395C.en: 「Fated ones meeting across time.../ Truly dramatic.」

0x0039E6.en: 「This gathering of psychic power... I don't like it.」

0x003A23.en: 「Temporary though it is,/ that surge of psychic power is impressive.」

0x003A76.en: 「A Chokijin of the Four Gods/ making the OhRyuKoh flinch...」

0x003AFA.en: 「Did I touch a nerve of yours?」

0x003B65.en: 「Guess I ought to let my guard down for you」

0x003C04.en: 「Hm? Is that the end of your act?」

0x003C41.en: 「I'd like a bit more flash, really.」

0x003CA3.en: 「Desperation is fine./ For humans, that is.」

0x003CED.en: 「A finite life is such a sad thing.」

0x003D21.en: 「Well,/ giving up too easily would be dull.」

0x003D6B.en: 「Kusuha,/ cute face, but you sure play rough.」

0x003E57.en: 「Shikai and your psychic power would grow stronger.」

0x003E97.en: 「Know why the number of psychics/ has grown?」

0x003EF0.en: 「Can't you feel the gap in psychic power?」

0x003F24.en: 「That device is a bit of a bother./ Well, I'll manage it later.」

0x003F8F.en: 「That device is too much for you, no?」

0x003FCF.en: 「Now, I wonder how you'll end up.」

0x00403D.en: 「Was that intro just off the cuff?」

0x004071.en: 「A bit younger and I'd fight/ like that man did.」

0x0040BE.en: 「A Chokijin of the Four Gods/ ought to manage that much.」

0x00413F.en: 「Let's liven it up more,/ this dragon-tiger clash.」

0x0041AE.en: 「No damage makes for a dull show.」

0x004228.en: 「Use your head a little when you attack.」

0x0042EF.en: 「It shook, it shook... just a tiny bit.」

0x004436.en: 「Well, a fair bit of psychic power.」

0x004492.en: 「Nice psychic power. Come join us?/ ...Just kidding.」

0x004519.en: 「Riding that thing may bring/ you trouble later, you know?」

0x0045D1.en: 「Lines I've heard before, moves I've seen before.」

0x004614.en: 「Heheh, I told you, didn't I?/ This is a Chokijin of the Four Spirits.../ A cut above the Four Gods.」

0x004683.en: 「Well, that's all a Four Gods Chokijin amounts to.」

0x0046FA.en: 「Yep, yep, your bark's full-grown at least.」

0x004781.en: 「Hey now,/ can't hit a target this big?」

0x004808.en: 「Heheh... it's what you'd call a barrier.」

0x00486A.en: 「Let's have you try a little harder.」

0x0048C3.en: 「A psychic barrier.../ Don't call it cowardly, alright?」

0x004920.en: 「Nothing for it... I'll let you slide.」

0x004954.en: 「Good grief, seems I got a bit carried away.」

0x004991.en: 「Whoops... did I lose sight of you?」

0x0049C2.en: 「Guess they've got me beat at running away?」

0x004A21.en: 「Then I'll be the one to finish you.」

0x004B3F.en: 「Obeying the God of Baral is only natural.」

0x004BD2.en: 「Gotta do this sort of thing now and then.」

0x004C2B.en: 「Come now, old-timer, step back, step back.」

0x004CD3.en: 「Guarding the God of Baral is a Chokijin's duty.」

0x004D91.en: 「Should've just run off while you could.」

0x004DE7.en: 「Here they come, more and more!/ On and on, they keep pouring out!」

0x004E40.en: 「Ryurin Ranbujin, let's give it a go!」

0x004E71.en: 「OhRyuKoh's this big, after all,/ so there's no counting all these scales!」

0x004F0D.en: 「Even I don't know how many of them there are!/ Too much bother to count!」

0x004FF7.en: 「A dragon, so I called up a twister too!」

0x00512D.en: 「Now then, let's go out with a bang!」
